name: triage-issue
description: Reads a new issue, assesses its severity and decides whether more information is needed.

inputs.name: priorityHint
inputs.description: Optional priority hint for the triage agent

outputs.name: severity
outputs.description: One of low, medium, high, critical

outputs.name: needsInfo
outputs.description: True when the reporter must provide more details

promptTemplate:
Triage issue {{ref}} in repository {{repository}}.
Priority hint: {{inputs.priorityHint}}

Read the issue, decide its severity and whether the reporter must provide more information.
Respond with a JSON object: {"severity": "low|medium|high|critical", "needsInfo": true|false}.
